title: Easy Drop Biscuits
description: This easy drop biscuit recipe only requires 5 simple ingredients! In under 30 minutes you can have homemade drop biscuits on your table!

ingredients.prep: very cold, cut into small pieces

ingredients.note: 170-227 grams (¾-1 cup, 180-240 milliliters); start with the smaller amount and add more if batter is very dry

steps.title: Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together {i01} (240 grams/ 2 cups), {i02} (14 grams/ 1 tablespoon), and {i03} (1 ¼ teaspoons) together.

steps.title: Cut In Butter
steps.text: Add the pieces of cold {i04} (113 grams/ ½ cup) and cut into the dry ingredients with a pastry cutter or fork until the consistency of coarse meal. If you want to add any cheeses or other add-ins you can stir them in here before adding the milk.

steps.title: Add Milk and Mix
steps.text: Add the smaller amount of the {i05} (170 grams/ ¾ cup) and stir just until combined. If the batter is very dry, add a little more milk until the consistency resembles a very thick batter. Do not over-mix. The batter will be quite lumpy.

steps.title: Drop Biscuits
steps.text: Drop large mounds (about ¼ cup each, I like to use a 2 ounce cookie scoop) onto either a parchment lined baking sheet or buttered cast iron skillet. The mounds can be touching on the sides.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 16-20 minutes until golden brown.

steps.title: Finish and Serve
steps.text: Brush with {i06} and sprinkle with {i07} if desired.
